brief:
Project: Maple & Fern Bakery rebrand.
Create two logo concepts in full colour.
Develop one selected logo with the bakery tagline.
Design a double-sided business card.
Design one A2 menu board.
Provide a brand colour palette.
Provide a favicon based on the selected logo.
Two revision rounds are included for the agreed designs.
Initial concepts are due 20 October 2026.
Final agreed assets are due 30 October 2026.
message: Hi Rowan, thanks for the concepts! Please don't change the logo, just make the tagline a bit bigger. Could you add a social media kit for Instagram with five templates? Also, could you make the menu board feel more premium? By the Instagram kit I mean a set of five reusable social post templates. Thanks for helping us get ready for opening day!
